inputs: configs/psbd_basis.json (panel rule retargeted to swin, 93 panel cells)

SwinCells.meaning: Swin cells that are successful backdoors (ASR bar and 2-point clean-accuracy bar) and carry PSBD metrics

SwinCellsImplanted.meaning: Swin cells whose attack cleared the ASR bar and carry PSBD metrics, whatever their clean accuracy

SwinPanelCellsTotal.meaning: cells the ViT panel rule selects on Swin-S, clearing or not

SwinPanelCellsSuccessful.meaning: Swin panel cells that are successful backdoors at the headline bar, carrying a sweep or not

SwinPanelCellsAwaitingSweep.meaning: successful Swin panel cells without a psbd_metrics.json

SwinCellsFailingCleanBar.meaning: implanted Swin cells left out because clean accuracy fell more than 2 points below the benign Swin model

SwinDatasets.meaning: datasets with at least 1 successful Swin cell

SwinPlacementsReported.meaning: Swin placements with at least 5 successful cells

SwinCellsTiny.meaning: successful Swin cells on Tiny ImageNet

SwinGainRecommendedMinusPublished.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus dropout, after both residual adds, adaptive rule, over 63 cells

SwinGainDropoutInputMinusPublished.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, dropout, attention input minus dropout, after both residual adds, adaptive rule, over 63 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusPreResidual.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus dropout, before both residual adds, adaptive rule, over 63 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusTwin.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus token mask, attention output before the add, adaptive rule, over 63 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusSameSiteDropout.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus dropout, attention input, adaptive rule, over 63 cells

SwinSelectionHalfRecommendedAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the recommended placement on the selection half, 32 cells

SwinSelectionHalfTwinAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the twin placement on the selection half, 34 cells

SwinSelectionHalfTwinGap.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gap, recommended minus twin, selection half, 32 cells

SwinReportHalfRecommendedAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the recommended placement on the report half, 31 cells

SwinReportHalfTwinAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the twin placement on the report half, 31 cells

SwinReportHalfTwinGap.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gap, recommended minus twin, report half, 31 cells

SwinRecommendedFloor.meaning: lowest single-model AUROC of the recommended placement on Swin

SwinRecommendedBelowChance.meaning: Swin cells where the recommended placement reads below chance

SwinShiftTargetUnreached.meaning: Swin cells whose swept rate ladder never reached the adaptive shift target

SwinHardestAttacks.meaning: the attacks holding the 4 lowest Swin readings of the recommended placement

SwinSeedReplicates.meaning: Swin training-seed replicate checkpoints on disk

SwinRecommendedAurocAdaptive.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule over 63 cells

SwinRecommendedN.meaning: Swin cells carrying the recommended placement

SwinRecommendedTprOneZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of token mask, attention input at the q0.10 budget over 63 cells

SwinRecommendedTprTwoZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of token mask, attention input at the q0.20 budget over 63 cells

SwinPublishedTprOneZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of dropout, after both residual adds at the q0.10 budget over 65 cells

SwinPublishedTprTwoZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of dropout, after both residual adds at the q0.20 budget over 65 cells

SwinSameSiteDropoutAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of dropout at the attention input over 63 cells

SwinPublishedAurocAdaptive.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the published placement at the adaptive rule over 65 cells

SwinCellsFivePoint.meaning: at the 5-point clean-accuracy bar, Swin cells that are successful backdoors

SwinRecommendedAurocAdaptiveFivePoint.meaning: at the 5-point clean-accuracy bar, Swin mean AUROC of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule over 63 cells

SwinPublishedAurocAdaptiveFivePoint.meaning: at the 5-point clean-accuracy bar, Swin mean AUROC of the published placement at the adaptive rule over 65 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusPublishedFivePoi.meaning: at the 5-point clean-accuracy bar, Swin paired AUROC gain of recommended over published over 63 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusPublishedLowFive.meaning: at the 5-point clean-accuracy bar, lower bootstrap bound of the Swin paired gain

SwinGainRecommendedMinusPublishedHighFiv.meaning: at the 5-point clean-accuracy bar, upper bootstrap bound of the Swin paired gain
